scenes.text: You probably think you know absolutely everything about Earth’s oceans, but there is a massive, secret body of water hidden deep under your feet.
Scientists recently discovered a colossal reservoir four hundred miles beneath the crust, trapped inside a strange, blue, glowing sponge-like rock called ringwoodite.

This subterranean ocean actually holds three times more water than all our surface oceans combined, meaning if it ever seeped up, the entire planet would be completely submerged with only mountain peaks remaining.

This mind-blowing discovery completely changes how we think about our origin, so do you believe there could be ancient life hidden down there? Tell me what you think in the comments and follow for more.
